messages:
Alex Kim: Hey team — need short-lived k8s admin for a one-off node drain + restart to finish a kernel patch rollout on prod cluster (cluster-prod-us-east-1). Will be touching node labels and daemonset pods. Request window: today 20:30–21:00 UTC. Ticket: #INC-4321 (patch rollout).

Maria Fernandez: Can you paste the exact commands you'll run and confirm no logs or stack traces with secrets will be uploaded to the cluster logs? Need to confirm redaction and retention settings before approving. Also include which namespaces you'll touch.

Alex Kim: Commands below — will only cordon/drain + restart and uncordon. Namespaces: infra, payments, billing-worker. Not touching customer data services.

```
kubectl cordon ip-10-0-12-45.us-east-1
kubectl drain ip-10-0-12-45.us-east-1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m
# ops will restart the node via cloud console
kubectl uncordon ip-10-0-12-45.us-east-1
```

Logs: we will not enable debug or attach logs beyond normal kubelet/journal logs. I will scrub pod logs before posting any excerpts.

Jamal Reed: Quick checklist: manager approval + 2FA SSO for the elevation window, and we need a list of exact IAM roles you want elevated to (e.g., k8s-admin via rbac:cluster-admin). We use short-lived K8S elevated sessions — security will create an audit entry. Please ping your manager to confirm.

Alex Kim: Requesting RBAC role: cluster-admin binding limited to the node/drain verbs via a scoped role we've used before (scoped-node-maintainer). Manager pinged (@maria) — Maria, can you approve?

Maria Fernandez: Approved for the requested window and role, condition: no portability of kubeconfig, and record commands in the ticket. I'll leave this approval in the ticket. :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: I'll be on standby for the node restart and will handle the cloud restart step to avoid exposing cloud console creds. Schedule it at 20:35 UTC. Ops will also ensure the node's cloud-init logs are redacted when uploaded to central logging.

security-bot: Policy notice: Temporary elevation request (thread 1767800123) logged. Audit ID: AUD-2026-09-17-78. Elevation token to be created after 2FA SSO verification.

Alex Kim: Thanks all — starting at 20:35 UTC. Will update ticket with exact timing and paste scrubbed command output.

Maria Fernandez: Reminder: keep any screenshots redacted (use <REDACTED> for IPs/ARNs). If you need to paste kube logs here, remove any secrets and run `sops` or our log-scrub script before posting.

Alex Kim: Understood — will use the scrub script and attach only the audit ID and a short summary. Thanks! :thumbsup:
